"""Summaries."""
import time

import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()


def summarize(text: str) -> str:
    """Summarize text."""
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            return client.messages.create(
                model="m-1",
                max_tokens=200,
                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": text}],
            )
        except anthropic.RateLimitError:
            time.sleep(2 * 2 ** attempt)
